$description: Raw scales. Components never read these directly; they read the semantic tier.

rainbow.$description: The six stops of the site's rainbow.

palette.$description: Named palettes, each one OKLCH base at step 500. The build generates every other step from the base by the fractions in io.github.neatlittlemacapps.nigari.steps: a lighter step moves that fraction of the way from the base's lightness to white, a darker one that fraction of the way to black; hue stays, chroma is lowered only to fit sRGB (spec 019, R1). Write only the base. To change a colour everywhere, change its palette's base, or point the role tokens in semantic.tokens.json at another palette. Components never read a palette step (check-tokens.mjs refuses --palette-*): they use the role tokens.

raspberry.$description: Primary. Its base is today's accent on paper (#b3123f).

burnt-orange.$description: Destructive. Its base is today's danger on paper (#c2410c).

stone.$description: The warm grey of light mode: paper, ink and muted text. Its base is light muted text (#6f6e6a).

slate.$description: The cool grey of dark mode: the night surfaces and mist text. Its base is dark muted text (#808083).

size.$description: Seven steps (research P3). Literal sizes move onto them batch by batch.

display.$description: Page titles and empty states: fluid from 28px to 40px.

family.$description: The two faces the app ships (bundled, never fetched from a CDN).

mono.$description: Labels and buttons in the brand typeface; code.

radius.$description: Research P4. Under scale, because --radius-sm and --radius-lg already name today's 7px and 14px (semantic radius.legacy) and theme.css and the public pages read them.

space.$description: The spacing values the stylesheet uses most (measured: 8, 6, 4, 2, 10, 12, 16, 24px). The name counts quarters of 4px: 100 = 4px, 250 = 10px.

layer.$description: Named z-index layers instead of 24 numbers (research P4).

tooltip.$description: Above every other layer, top included: a tooltip names the control under the pointer, and the anchored icon picker (top, 1200) drew over its own trash button's tooltip at 1000 (spec 020, found by review).

out.$description: The ease-out every panel and menu uses.

rainbow.$description: The site's six stops. There is no second colour system.
